description_full:
Hi Students & Fresh Grads - Your NEXT BIG STEP starts HERE!

TBIG Internship Program is officially OPEN 🌟
If you're eager to learn, excited to explore, and ready to gain real-working experience! This is your moment!

🔗 Register: https://tbig.link/ApplyTBIGIn17
⏳ Deadline: Dec 11, 2026

Let's turn your potential into real impact.

Note: This program is paid internship & will be conducted at TBIG Head Office, Jakarta.
